name: Eldaa
title: Son of Midian
summary: Eldaa was the youngest of Midian's sons and thus a grandson of Abraham through his wife Keturah. He is regarded as one of the ancestors of the Midianite tribes who lived in northwestern Arabia. His descendants played a role in later biblical accounts concerning the Midianites.

keyEvents.title: Abraham's marriage to Keturah
keyEvents.description: After Sarah's death, Abraham took Keturah as his wife, and she bore him sons, including Midian, who became Eldaa's father.

keyEvents.title: Eldaa's birth and lineage
keyEvents.description: Eldaa is mentioned as the fifth and youngest son of Midian, and thus as a grandson of Abraham through the Keturah line.

keyEvents.title: The Genealogy in First Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Eldaa is also mentioned in the genealogies of Chronicles, confirming his position as a son of Midian and a descendant of Abraham.

keyEvents.title: Abraham's Gifts to Keturah's Sons
keyEvents.description: Abraham gave gifts to the sons of his concubines, including the line of Midian, and sent them eastward away from Isaac while he was still alive.
